normalization: Preserve every point/boundary. Negate Tomoe downward-positive Y for the input of existing normalizeMedians, which inverts it back, fits an 80-unit extent, and rounds to 0.1 units.

blockers.note: Domestic 艹 has two separate horizontal strokes and two verticals (4 strokes); Tomoe uses one continuous horizontal plus two verticals (3 strokes). Equal total count conceals this boundary mismatch.

Domestic lower 乃 uses a separate left-falling stroke followed by a continuous multi-bend right stroke. Tomoe splits the right bend across candidate 9/10 and puts the left stroke at 11. A permutation cannot restore the boundaries.

entries.release: Complete licensed 11-stroke geometry with domestic four-stroke 艹 and two-stroke 乃; no arbitrary split or merge.

blockers.note: Domestic 12 is right-then-down and domestic 13 is a separate rightward bar. Tomoe 12 is only the top bar and Tomoe 13 is down-then-right; the same two strokes have different boundaries.
The lower inner vertical terminates at the horizontal corner, while the domestic vertical projects below the crossbar.

entries.release: Full 15-stroke paths with matching lower-gate boundaries and projecting inner verticals.

blockers.note: The domestic lower inner verticals extend below the joining horizontal. Tomoe forms rounded corners terminating on the horizontal, producing a different lower-gate contour even though the stroke counts/order agree.

entries.release: Full 13-stroke paths whose lower gate preserves the domestic inner-vertical projections and junctions.

blockers.note: The domestic water stroke starts with a downward movement before rising; Tomoe's point sequence rises immediately and lacks that descending segment.

Tomoe writes the long left vertical before the inner bend/bars, whereas the domestic reference writes that long vertical last in this group. This order difference alone is permutable, but does not fix stroke 3.

entries.release: Licensed whole-glyph geometry supporting the domestic water stroke's initial downward segment; then verify the candidate order correction and all 14 cumulative states.

blockers.note: The domestic upper-right dot meets the enclosure's top/right area, but Tomoe's dot is detached above it.

At the reviewed normalized widths the Tomoe final stroke joins the long horizontal above, while the domestic final stroke starts below it with separation. Whole-form review confirms this unwanted junction.

entries.release: Complete 17-stroke geometry with the domestic upper-dot junction and lower-right separation; retain catalog 18 versus playback 17 if later approved.

blockers.note: Tomoe's 金 right roof and the next component's first left-falling stroke meet, while the domestic 金/隹 components are separated.
As in 雋, the lower inner verticals terminate at the crossbar corners rather than extending below them as in the domestic reference.

entries.release: Complete 21-stroke geometry preserving 金/隹 separation and domestic lower-gate junctions.
